---
title: "Complex-IV_activity"
output: html_notebook
---

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)
library(rstatix)
library(patchwork)

# Load and clean dataset
df <- read_excel("combined_df.xlsx", sheet = "Raw") %>%
  mutate(Time = factor(Time, levels = c("TD", "Baseline", "EndPart1", "EndPart2")),
         Group = factor(Group, levels = c("TD", "Group-A", "Group-B")),
         fill_group = as.character(Group)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(PatientID), !is.na(Time), !is.na(Group), !is.na(ComplexIV_activity))

y_pos <- max(df$ComplexIV_activity, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.25
```


```{r}
# TD vs Baseline comparison
td_baseline_df <- df %>%
  filter(Time %in% c("TD", "Baseline")) %>%
  mutate(Comparison = factor(if_else(Time == "TD", "TD", "Baseline"),
                             levels = c("TD", "Baseline")))

td_baseline_test <- td_baseline_df %>%
  t_test(ComplexIV_activity ~ Comparison)

td_baseline_d <- td_baseline_df %>%
  cohens_d(ComplexIV_activity ~ Comparison, hedges.correction = FALSE) %>%
  pull(effsize)

td_p <- td_baseline_test %>% pull(p)
label_td <- sprintf("p=%.3f (es=%.2f)", td_p, td_baseline_d)
```


```{r}
# Group comparison at EndPart1
group_comparison_df <- df %>%
  filter(Time == "EndPart1") %>%
  mutate(Group2 = factor(Group, levels = c("Group-A", "Group-B")))

group_comparison_test <- group_comparison_df %>%
  t_test(ComplexIV_activity ~ Group2)

group_comparison_d <- group_comparison_df %>%
  cohens_d(ComplexIV_activity ~ Group2, hedges.correction = FALSE) %>%
  pull(effsize)

ep1_p <- group_comparison_test %>% pull(p)
label_ep1 <- sprintf("p=%.3f (es=%.2f)", ep1_p, group_comparison_d)
```


```{r}
base_font <- 14
dodge_w <- 0.6

p_td <- ggplot() +
  geom_boxplot(
    data = df %>% filter(Time == "TD"),
    aes(x = "TD", y = ComplexIV_activity),
    width = 0.5, outlier.shape = NA, color = "black", fill = "#FFB703"
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    data = df %>% filter(Time == "TD"),
    aes(x = "TD", y = ComplexIV_activity),
    shape = 21, color = "black", fill = "#FFB703",
    stroke = 0.5, size = 3, width = 0.08, alpha = 0.95
  ) +
  geom_boxplot(
    data = df %>% filter(Time == "Baseline"),
    aes(x = "Baseline", y = ComplexIV_activity),
    width = 0.5, outlier.shape = NA, color = "black", fill = "#0077CC"
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    data = df %>% filter(Time == "Baseline"),
    aes(x = "Baseline", y = ComplexIV_activity),
    shape = 21, color = "black", fill = "#0077CC",
    stroke = 0.5, size = 3, width = 0.08, alpha = 0.95
  ) +
  annotate("segment", x = 1, xend = 2, y = y_pos, yend = y_pos, linewidth = 0.6) +
  annotate("segment", x = 1, xend = 1, y = y_pos, yend = y_pos - 0.12, linewidth = 0.6) +
  annotate("segment", x = 2, xend = 2, y = y_pos, yend = y_pos - 0.12, linewidth = 0.6) +
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = y_pos + 0.3, label = label_td, size = 4) +
  theme_classic(base_size = base_font) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 10)) +
  labs(y = "Mitochondrial protein Complex-IV activity\n(nanomoles/min/mg-protein)")
```


```{r}
# Main longitudinal plot
p_main <- ggplot(df %>% filter(Time != "TD"), aes(x = Time, y = ComplexIV_activity)) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c(Baseline = "Baseline", EndPart1 = "EndPart 1", EndPart2 = "EndPart 2")) +
  geom_boxplot(
    aes(fill = fill_group, group = interaction(Time, Group)),
    position = position_dodge(width = dodge_w),
    width = 0.5, outlier.shape = NA, color = "black"
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    aes(fill = fill_group),
    shape = 21, color = "black", stroke = 0.5, size = 3,
    position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15, dodge.width = dodge_w),
    alpha = 0.95, show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  annotate("segment", x = 1.8, xend = 2.2, y = y_pos, yend = y_pos, linewidth = 0.6) +
  annotate("segment", x = 1.8, xend = 1.8, y = y_pos, yend = y_pos - 0.12, linewidth = 0.6) +
  annotate("segment", x = 2.2, xend = 2.2, y = y_pos, yend = y_pos - 0.12, linewidth = 0.6) +
  annotate("text", x = 2, y = y_pos + 0.3, label = label_ep1, size = 4) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Group-A" = "#27b85c", "Group-B" = "purple"),
    breaks = c("Group-A", "Group-B"),
    labels = c("Group-A", "Group-B")
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = base_font) +
  theme(
    legend.position = c(0.82, 0.85),
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    axis.line.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 10)) +
  labs(y = NULL)

combined_plot <- p_td + p_main +
  plot_layout(widths = c(1.1, 3))

print(combined_plot)
```


```{r}
ggsave("mitochondrial_combined_plot.pdf", combined_plot, width = 7, height = 5.5, dpi = 300)
ggsave("mitochondrial_combined_plot.png", combined_plot, width = 7, height = 5.5, dpi = 600)
```
